summary: Mollie. Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 88% of its 8 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 1 about funding; 3 about acquisitions.

insights.one_liner: Amsterdam payments company used by 250,000+ businesses; IND sponsor with mostly English tech and finance roles and frequent visa mentions.

culture.text: Staff often come from UvA, VU, Amsterdam UAS, Maastricht and Zuyd, studying computer science, economics and business.
An 850-strong team with offices in Amsterdam, Ghent, Lisbon, London, Maastricht, Milan, Munich, Berlin, Kiel and Paris.

open.text: Mollie B.V. and Mollie Business B.V. are IND recognised sponsors.

growth.text: Founded in 2004; now more than 250,000 businesses use it.
Launched its own Pay by Bank product as an alternative to iDEAL and Wero.

worth_knowing.text: Its new iDEAL competitor launches without the debated buyer protection.
